articles.title: Bitcoin eyes new August lows as Binance longs face ‘cleanout’
articles.snippet: Bitcoin futures open interest on Binance fell alongside BTC price as analysis published on CryptoQuant flagged mounting pressure on leveraged longs.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation pivots away from Poseidon in post-quantum plan
articles.snippet: Advances in compact proofs have erased Poseidon’s previous performance advantage, according to researcher Justin Drake.
